title: The Stock Market Is Starting To Tell A Different Story
speaker: Geeks of Finance hosts (Anthony, Shawn)

macro_themes.view: SPX flipped barely back into positive GEX and the market is still at a decision point mid sell-off range ahead of monthly OPEX.
SaaS names are making a comeback and could see further gains (Adobe, ServiceNow, Salesforce).

calls.reason: Bounce off the 50-day EMA (7681), where buyers have stepped in for 6 months, plus +$256M delta-weighted net SPX call flow.
calls.quote: we're looking for something similar with some follow-through here in the coming sessions.

calls.condition: Still in negative GEX, so alternative path is a drop to 700.
calls.reason: QQQ rebounding from the lower dealer cluster zone; expects retest of declining moving averages (HMA) and OPEX max pain not to the downside.
calls.quote: the Nasdaq has a good chance to rebound with QQQ potentially reaching 740 on Friday.

calls.reason: Breakout from a month-long consolidation through positive GEX and above the 50-day EMA; SaaS comeback theme. Closed a 250/240 put credit spread for a gain.
calls.quote: SaaS names in general are making a comeback and we could see further gains ahead.

calls.reason: Steady uptrend holding 9 SMA/15 EMA/HMA (340.51) aligned with GEX at 340; large call activity at 360 lines up with upper Keltner channel.
calls.quote: as long as Apple holds 340, I'm looking for Apple to potentially hit 350 to 360 in coming weeks.

notes: Date inferred: 'tomorrow is the monthly OPEX for October' (Fri 2026-10-16) and QQQ target 'on Friday', so recorded Thu 2026-10-15 after close; listing said 10-16. QQQ 760/800 described as not invalidated rather than firm targets. Third speaker (Apple segment) unnamed.
